key.name: refresh-interval-minutes
key.description: How often enabled providers should be refreshed.

key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: Provider identifiers that participate in refreshes and rendering.

key.name: panel-target
key.description: Use the GNOME main panel or an available bottom Dash to Panel panel.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Position inside the GNOME main panel
key.description: Which box of the main panel hosts Quota Glance. Ignored on Dash to Panel.

key.name: proxy-url
key.summary: Proxy URL used for provider requests
key.description: Overrides the proxy from the environment. Empty keeps the environment value.

key.name: proxy-no-proxy
key.description: Comma separated list passed to the proxy resolver.

key.name: dash-to-panel-available
key.description: Runtime state used to show the panel location preference only when a bottom Dash to Panel exists.

key.name: codex-show-primary-window
key.description: Whether the primary Codex rate-limit window is shown in the panel.
